title: GST Invoice Engine
desc: Paise-exact GST invoices: CGST/SGST/UTGST/IGST by place of supply, SEZ & exports, cess, HSN summary, round-off and amount in words.

title: India KYC Validators
desc: Zero-dependency validators for GSTIN (mod-36 checksum), PAN, TAN, IFSC, Aadhaar (Verhoeff), UPI, PIN code and vehicle numbers.

title: Income Tax Calculator
desc: Old vs new regime for FY 2025-26 with 87A marginal relief, surcharge relief, HRA and break-even deductions. Live web app.

title: Bank Reconciliation
desc: Five-pass matching (UTR/cheque, date window, fuzzy narration, split deposits) that produces a ready Bank Reconciliation Statement.

title: Tally XML Bridge
desc: Spreadsheets to Tally Prime import XML (vouchers, GST sales, ledger masters) and Tally exports back to CSV, with validation.

title: GeM Bid Analyzer
desc: Eligibility go/no-go with document checklist, L1 ranking with MSE & Make-in-India preference, and price advice from past awards.

title: ledger-cli
desc: Plain-text double-entry accounting: balance assertions, trial balance, P&L and balance sheet with Indian number formatting.

title: LSM-tree Key-Value Store
desc: Crash-safe storage engine: write-ahead log, skip-list memtable, SSTables with sparse index and Bloom filters, compaction, manifest.

title: rhttp — HTTP/1.1 Server
desc: HTTP server from scratch with std only: thread pool, keep-alive and pipelining, router with params, static files with ETags.

title: rzip Compressor
desc: LZ77 with hash chains + canonical length-limited Huffman coding and CRC-32. Matches gzip's compression ratio.

title: Dancing Links Solver
desc: Knuth's Algorithm X with Dancing Links in C11: generic exact cover, Sudoku up to 25×25 and N-Queens. Sanitizer-clean.

title: tinylang Interpreter
desc: A small programming language: hand-written lexer, Pratt parser, closures, maps, ranges, string interpolation and a REPL.

title: csvql — SQL on CSV
desc: A query engine for CSV files: joins (hash + nested loop), GROUP BY, HAVING, CASE, LIKE and three-valued NULL logic.

title: ratelimit-go
desc: Token bucket, fixed & sliding window and GCRA behind one API, with 64-shard locking and net/http middleware.

title: taskq Job Queue
desc: Durable background jobs on SQLite: atomic claims, leases with heartbeats, backoff with jitter, dead-letter queue, asyncio workers.

title: cronkit
desc: Cron parser and scheduler with seconds, L, nth weekday, IANA time zones and correct DST handling, plus plain-English descriptions.

title: textdiff
desc: Myers O(ND) diff, git-compatible unified diffs, offset-tolerant patching, diff3 three-way merge and word-level diffs.

title: sitecrawler
desc: Polite concurrent crawler: robots.txt (RFC 9309), per-host rate limits, broken-link report and sitemap.xml generation.

title: Pathfinding Visualiser
desc: Watch A*, Dijkstra, BFS, bidirectional BFS, greedy and DFS search a weighted grid; animated maze generation. Live demo.

title: Settle Up
desc: Split group expenses four ways and settle with the provably minimum number of payments (bitmask DP). Offline, shareable by link.

title: minigit — Git from scratch
desc: A small, readable Git in Python that writes Git's real object, tree, commit and index formats — the real git opens its repositories.

title: tinyredis — Redis in Go
desc: A small Redis server that real redis-cli talks to: RESP protocol, strings, lists, hashes, TTL expiry, pipelining and AOF persistence.

title: apicheck
desc: API tests as plain JSON files: chained requests with saved variables, JSON-path matchers, timing limits and JUnit reports for CI. Zero dependencies.
